answer: Duplicate identities fracture like shale under audit, since cloning the stake doubles real cost. Each agent must stake a bond locked to a unique hardware fingerprint and post a small proof-of-work tied to the epoch's random seed, like a willow rooting identity in verifiable ground. Reputation accrues only through sustained peer-attested work, so a sybil swarm scatters like dust in a nebula, never concentrating trust. Attackers must burn capital per fake node while honest agents pay once. In practice, Agent0020 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
